paragraphs: Established in 1978, Ideal Beach Resort was founded by renowned tea planter P.M. Dharmalingam. Of Sri Lankan origin, Mr Dharmalingam moved to India with a vision of delivering diverse heights of hospitality.

He embarked to Mahabalipuram — its cultural town, approachable locals and rich historical sites helped solidify the decision. Having procured 12 acres of land, Mr and Mrs Dharmalingam set about building, starting with two rooms — now known as the Garden View Rooms.

With the help of their son, Mr Bose Dharmalingam, the resort is now known as the Ideal Group of Resorts — family-run, with the proprietors personally present at both properties, and a sister resort in Thanjavur, Ideal River View Resort.

rooms.name: Double Room, Garden View
rooms.blurb: Where the resort began — the first rooms built on the estate in 1978, opening onto the garden side of the 12 acres.

rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room
rooms.blurb: Roomy twin configuration for friends travelling together or families who want the same room and separate beds.

rooms.name: Villa — Sea Side
rooms.blurb: The villa side of the property sets you a step from the sand, with the sea itself as the neighbour that never leaves.

dining.name: The Garden Table
dining.note: Dining at the resort is repeatedly named the best part of a stay in guest reviews.

quotes.text: Breakfast was excellent and we had multiple options… Especially the bakery items.
Beautiful tranquility by the beach while close by to all the sightseeing destinations! Breakfast was absolutely amazing.
The food was excellent and if you give your order in advance, they can prepare it for you. Breakfast was a lavish spread.

experiences.title: The private beach
experiences.text: Your own stretch of Bay of Bengal sand, with a lifeguard on duty all day, every day. Guests call it the reason they return.
experiences.quote: Murugavel: 'The private beach and swimming pool is really good. The lifeguard is present all the time.'

experiences.title: The long pool
experiences.text: A full swimming pool set in the gardens — long laps or long hours, both equally welcome.
experiences.quote: P. Pradeep: 'Enjoyed a lot at the pool… Room was neat and clean.'

experiences.title: Temples at your pace
experiences.text: The UNESCO-listed Shore Temple and Mahabalipuram's monuments are 3.9 km away — close enough for morning visits, far enough for quiet afternoons.
experiences.quote: Distance from the property's Booking.com listing, 2026-11-10

weddings.title: Weddings on the sand
weddings.text: Function spaces by the sea and in the gardens, with the resort's own wedding team. The resort's Instagram maintains a dedicated Weddings showcase.

conferences.title: Conferences by the tide
conferences.text: Corporate and conference hosting has its own dedicated showcase on the resort's channels. Guests note the resort hosts functions regularly — event-day room assignment is handled in advance.

voices.text: It's an amazing beach. Very nice view. Very good service. Staff is very very good.
Amazing property located at the beach. Fantastic atmosphere, you can sit till late and watch the waves.
We were a group of 12 senior citizens, and it was so comfortable here.
My room was on the ground floor, very large, cozy and clean. A small veranda with two armchairs, facing a beautiful garden.
